```{r}
#|label: setup
#|echo: FALSE
#|message: FALSE
library(tidyverse)
library(flextable)
library(PxWebApiData)
library(readxl)
```

## Import Data

```{r}
arbled <- readxl::read_xlsx(
  path = "./Data/arbeidsledighet.xlsx",
  range = "A5:D17"
)
```

```{r}
arbled <- readxl::read_xlsx(
  path = "./Data/arbeidsledighet.xlsx",
  sheet = "10540",
  na = ":", 
  skip = 4, 
  n_max = 13)
```

## Reading csv file

```{r}
X10540_20260828_133036 <- read_delim("Data/10540_20260828-133036.csv", 
                                     delim = ";", escape_double = FALSE, locale = locale(encoding = "ISO-8859-1"), 
                                     trim_ws = TRUE, skip = 1)
```
